desc: Write a helper function to decompose a valid parenthesis sequence into its top-level primitive components. This can be done by scanning the string and tracking the balance; whenever the balance returns to 0, we have completed a primitive component.
Store each primitive component as a string in a list.
Use a hash map (or dictionary) to count the occurrences of each distinct primitive component.
Calculate the result using the multinomial coefficient formula: $k! \times \prod (count(c)!)^{-1} \pmod{998244353}$. Implement modular inverse for the division.
Read input from stdin, execute the logic, and print the result to stdout.
